description: This file is a shell script that manages changelog entries for pull requests. It includes functions for normalizing changelog entries, validating PR changelog updates, and ensuring merge hygiene related to changelog entries. The script interacts with 'CHANGELOG.md' and uses Node.js code to process file contents, indicating it combines shell scripting with JavaScript for specific tasks.

methods.name: normalize_pr_changelog_entries
methods.description: Normalizes changelog entries related to a specific PR by parsing and repositioning relevant lines within the CHANGELOG.md file.

methods.name: validate_changelog_entry_for_pr
methods.description: Validates that the changelog update for a PR references the correct PR number, is in the 'Unreleased' section, and is placed at the section tail.

methods.name: validate_changelog_merge_hygiene
methods.description: Ensures that during a merge, no PR references are mistakenly dropped from the changelog, maintaining merge integrity.
